---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused investigation capability or usability improvement
title: "[Feature] "
---

## User problem

What investigation or workflow is difficult today? Include a small, non-sensitive example.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired input, action and inspectable output. Identify the target family/adapter and whether it is currently demonstrated, experimental, import-only or planned.

## Contract and execution boundary

Which reviewed requirements or interfaces would change? How would the proposal preserve bounded execution, independent checking, replayable evidence and credential isolation?

## Acceptance evidence

What concrete checks would demonstrate this works? Distinguish unit/mocked checks from real simulator/model/vendor-tool acceptance. State any new tool, device or account prerequisite without including credentials.

## Alternatives and limits

What smaller approach could solve the problem? What is outside this proposal?
